title: Clean and Unclean Animals
summary: Clean and unclean animal distinctions shaped Israel’s diet, worship life, and covenant identity.
background: Leviticus and Deuteronomy identify animals considered clean or unclean. In the New Testament, these matters become central to teaching about Christ, Gentiles, and purity.
teachingHelp: Explain the old covenant distinction, then follow the passage’s own movement when teaching Acts, Mark, or Romans.
